function radioManager:update(delta)
    -- [perf patch] the car/pocket radio watchdog only needs to run 4x a second, not every frame
    self.vWatchElapsed = (self.vWatchElapsed or 1) + (delta or 0)
    if self.vWatchElapsed >= 0.25 then
        self.vWatchElapsed = 0
        self.managerV:update()
    end
    self.managerP:update() -- 3D position of world radios stays per frame

recipes.what: Checks 4 times a second (it ran every frame with up to 8 calls into the game) and switches the lamps once per new game minute.

ops.ins:
-- [perf patch] poll 4x a second (was every frame with up to 8 engine calls) and run Update()
-- once per new game minute (the original caught the exact :00 second by polling every frame)
local lampPollElapsed = 0
local lastLampMinute = nil

lampPollElapsed = lampPollElapsed + (dt or 0)
    if lampPollElapsed < 0.25 then return end
    lampPollElapsed = 0
    local srh = Game.GetSystemRequestsHandler()
    if srh:IsPreGame() or srh:IsGamePaused() then return end
    local ts = Game.GetTimeSystem()
    if not ts then return end
    local gt = ts:GetGameTime()
    if not gt or not gt.seconds then return end

local minute = math.floor(gt.seconds / 60)
        if lastLampMinute ~= minute then
            if lastLampMinute ~= nil then Update() end
            lastLampMinute = minute

recipes.what: The weather check runs 4 times a second instead of every frame, with one system lookup instead of three; cloud transitions still move every frame.

ops.ins:
-- [perf] 22 Oct 2026: throttle for the weather-state check (see onUpdate)
local WS_CHECK_EVERY = 0.25
local wsCheckTimer = 0

-- [perf] 22 Oct 2026: one system-handler lookup instead of three
	local srh = Game.GetSystemRequestsHandler()

not srh or
	   srh:IsGamePaused() or
	   srh:IsPreGame() then

-- [perf] 22 Oct 2026: the weather-state check runs 4x a second instead of every frame.
	-- Cloud transitions still advance every frame and the history timer still gets every frame's time.
	wsCheckTimer = wsCheckTimer + delta
	if wsCheckTimer >= WS_CHECK_EVERY then
		local skipped = wsCheckTimer - delta
		wsCheckTimer = 0
		if skipped > 0 then HT.AccumulateDelta(skipped) end
		WM.Update(delta)
	else
		CC.UpdateTransition(delta)
	end
